description: Pyth Product. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/products/{productAddress} and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Pyth product metadata on Solana. Get product account details, asset type, and associated price feed accounts.

productAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/oracle/pyth/products/{productAddress}.
